title: The complete slab-one sublevel cover is excluded above the slab-three threshold
scope_guard: K1769 covers every possible degree-seven competitor, K1777 closes the only lower-boundary strip, and K1791 removes all 37 slab-one interior cells at degree nine. The result excludes slab one at the declared threshold but says nothing global about the 25 retained leaves in slabs two and three.
